decisions_log.decision: Named the new URL-params test file filter-url-sync.test.tsx rather than ChangelogFilteredList.urlparams.test.tsx as suggested by the spec.
decisions_log.rationale: The spec noted the suggested filename as a convention prediction, not a requirement. filter-url-sync.test.tsx more clearly communicates that the tests cover URL synchronisation behaviour as a distinct concern, and sits naturally alongside the other changelog test files.

decisions_log.decision: Used a reactive mock pattern (useReducer + _forceUpdate) for next/navigation across all test files that render ChangelogFilteredList.
decisions_log.rationale: Because router.replace updates _currentParams (the URLSearchParams instance returned by useSearchParams), the component needs to re-render to pick up the new state. The useReducer forceUpdate pattern ensures the mock drives actual re-renders rather than just recording calls, making tests match production behaviour faithfully.

decisions_log.decision: Added { scroll: false } to router.replace calls in ChangelogFilteredList.
decisions_log.rationale: Filter changes should not scroll the page to the top. scroll: false is the standard option to preserve scroll position on router.replace in Next.js App Router.

deferred_questions.question: The Suspense boundary in app/changelog/page.tsx has no fallback prop (renders null during loading). The spec does not specify a fallback UI. If a loading skeleton or spinner is desired, that is a separate design decision.

Next.js 16 API for useSearchParams and router.replace could not be verified (node_modules docs unavailable per AGENTS.md warning). The implementation follows the Next.js 13-15 App Router convention; all tests pass and the build succeeds, which is the best available signal.

files_changed.summary: Replaced useState for selectedYear and searchQuery with URL-backed state via useSearchParams (read) and router.replace (write). Unknown year values in ?year= are silently ignored (fall back to null). Filter changes use router.replace with { scroll: false } to avoid polluting history.
Added <Suspense> boundary around <ChangelogFilteredList> as required by Next.js when rendering a useSearchParams consumer from a server component.
Added reactive jest.mock for next/navigation (useSearchParams, useRouter, usePathname) so existing 12 tests continue to pass after the component moved to URL-backed state.
Added same reactive jest.mock for next/navigation so existing title-search tests pass.
Added same reactive jest.mock for next/navigation so existing counts tests pass.
Added jest.mock for next/navigation to cover the server page component which now wraps ChangelogFilteredList in Suspense.

New test file covering URL-param initialisation and sync behaviour: ?year= and ?q= seed filters on load; absent params mean no filter; unknown year (?year=1999) is ignored; filter changes call router.replace not push; clearing filters removes params from URL.

self_assessment.notes: All 195 tests pass (npm test with --no-watchman). Lint (eslint) produces no output (clean). Build (next build) succeeds with TypeScript check passing. The 4 commits on the feature branch implement the change incrementally: (1) move filters to URL state, (2) add next/navigation mocks to existing tests, (3) add URL-param sync tests, (4) final integration commit.
